import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
open scoped BigOperators
theorem largest_modulus_sixteen_twentyfive :
    Nat.ModEq 9 16 25 ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → Nat.ModEq n 16 25 → n ≤ 9 := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem largest_modulus_sixteen_twentyfive :
    Nat.ModEq 9 16 25 ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → Nat.ModEq n 16 25 → n ≤ 9
    := by
  intro h1 h2
  have h3 : ∃ k : ℕ, 16 = 25 + k * 9 := by
    have h4 : 16 % 25 = 9 := Nat.ModEq.to_eq h1
    have h5 : 25 % 16 = 9 := by
      rw [Nat.ModEq.to_eq h2]
      simp
    have h6 : 16 - 9 = 25 - 9 := by
      rw [h4, h5]
      simp
    exact ⟨(16 - 9) / 9⟩
  obtain ⟨k, h6⟩ := h3
  have h7 : 16 = 25 + k * 9 := by
    rw [h6]
  have h8 : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → Nat.ModEq n 16 25 → n ≤ 9 := by
    intro n hn hnn
    have h9 : n % 25 = 16 % 25 := by
      rw [Nat.ModEq.to_eq hnn]
      simp
    have h10 : n % 25 = 9 := by
      rw [h9, h4]
    have h11 : n % 25 ≤ 9 := by
      rw [Nat.ModEq.to_le hnn]
      exact h10
    exact h11
  exact h8
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : Nl2LeanExpected.largest_modulus_sixteen_twentyfive = Nl2LeanCandidate.largest_modulus_sixteen_twentyfive := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
